product.name: Topkey Financial Operating System
product.description: A unified financial platform for vacation rental managers that automates expense management, bookkeeping, banking, corporate cards, and accounts payable.

identifier.value: Expense Management and Automated Receipt Capture

product.name: Expense Management and Automated Receipt Capture
product.description: Automates expense tracking by capturing receipts in real time, tagging transactions to properties, and integrating with PMS and accounting software.

identifier.value: Bill Pay and Accounts Payable Automation

product.name: Bill Pay and Accounts Payable Automation
product.description: Streamlines accounts payable with AI-driven invoice processing, vendor payments, property-level tagging, and customizable approval workflows.

product.name: Corporate and Virtual Company Cards
product.description: Provides physical and virtual company credit cards with real-time transaction visibility and property-level expense tracking.

identifier.value: Business Banking and Owner Deposit Accounts

product.name: Business Banking and Owner Deposit Accounts
product.description: Offers business checking and owner deposit accounts with integrated banking services and high-yield interest through a partner bank.
